issues.explanation: The printed term (INSO 15816-3 §3.7) is «هم‌رسانی داده‌ها (اشتراک داده)» — parenthetical included as part of the official printed form. The proposal strips the parenthetical to make «هم‌رسانی داده‌ها» the preferred entry and demotes the full printed form to alternatives_fa. Rule 1 requires preferred_fa to equal what the standard prints.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «هم‌رسانی داده‌ها (اشتراک داده)» and remove that same string from alternatives_fa.

issues.explanation: The printed term_fa (INSO 15816-3 §3.12) is «اطلاعات قابل‌شناسایی شخصی؛ داده‌های شخصی» — two co-printed preferred forms separated by a semicolon, exactly as ISO terminology conventions denote synonymous preferred terms. The proposal demotes «داده‌های شخصی» to alternatives_fa, reducing a co-preferred printed term to mere alias status. Rule 1 forbids this reassignment.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to the full joint printed form «اطلاعات قابل‌شناسایی شخصی؛ داده‌های شخصی» and remove «داده‌های شخصی» from alternatives_fa (it may be cross-referenced but not re-ranked).

issues.explanation: The printed term (INSO 23681 §3.1.2) is «مدل وایازش (رگرسیون)» — parenthetical included as part of the official printed form. The proposal strips the parenthetical to make «مدل وایازش» the preferred entry and demotes the full printed form to alternatives_fa, exactly as in the data sharing case. Rule 1 requires preferred_fa to equal what the standard prints.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «مدل وایازش (رگرسیون)» and remove that string from alternatives_fa.
